method: The flatness score (`score_telluric_correction.py`) judges a correction against a running mean of nearby clean pixels, which assumes the Sun is flat under a telluric line. Baker et al.'s atlas is the Sun itself, from the same instrument and the same quantity (disc-integrated flux) but other spectra (2015-16, through an iodine cell), with the atmosphere removed by a joint fit over air mass: the corrected 2014 atlas divided by it should be 1 wherever the correction is right, under solar lines too.
